target_customer: Wholesalers and distributors and their sales reps and counter staff
problem: Distributors handle quotes, orders, calls and ERP entry manually; Titanio uses AI agents to handle them.
business_model: B2B SaaS and AI agent services
product_category: AI sales and ordering for distribution

founders.name: Luis Mario Garcia
previous_startups: Orchata (YC W20 grocery delivery, reported $6.3M revenue and 30K customers on YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and messaging agents with ERP integrations such as Epicor, SAP and NetSuite are standard LLM engineering with hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations and order data create some lock-in, but many startups target the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; startups such as Canals ($35M, May 2026), Plato ($14.5M, Feb 2026) and Faction entered later.

market_need_then: Wholesale distribution is a large industry run on phone and email order desks; the team's earlier Orchata experience exposed the problem (RuntimeWire profile).

branding.domain_note: titanio.ai; the YC directory lists the company as Seals AI, and the site says it is operated by AI Founders, Inc.

brand_strength.rationale: Titanio is the product name and Seals AI the company identity; two names split recognition and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: A team of repeat founders from Orchata built AI agents for distributors and has widened from order entry to field sales, contact center and commerce. No funding round, exit or failure is documented by an opened primary source, and the field is getting well funded competitors, so the outcome is open.
notes: VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed in September 2024 with YC; another site lists Series A $500K; Latka says no outside funding. All unverified so no round. Orchata raised a reported $4M seed in July 2021 (a different company). The YC directory name is Titanio while the YC site also lists Seals AI; treated as one company. No dated competitor sources found. Competition list empty: no sources dated near the batch were found.
